summary: The University of Sydney funds international research students through the Australian Government's Research Training Program and its own University of Sydney International Stipend Scholarship (USYDIS), each paired with full tuition.
meta_description: University of Sydney research scholarships for international students: AUD 44,293 a year (2027), full tuition and health cover. Next deadline 18 December 2026.
covers: A stipend of AUD 44,293 a year at the 2027 rate (AUD 42,754 in 2026), from the RTP Stipend Scholarship or the USYDIS.
100% of tuition fees for up to 14 research periods, from the RTP Fee Offset or the University of Sydney Tuition Fee Scholarship, awarded automatically with the stipend.
Overseas Student Health Cover with the RTP Fee Offset.
eligibility: International students starting or enrolled in a higher degree by research.
Awarded competitively; preference may go to PhD applicants and to those who have not already held a scholarship at the same level.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission to your research degree through Sydney Courses, with all documents, by the international deadline.
Submit the scholarship application form by the same deadline: 18 December 2026 for research periods 3 and 4 of 2027.
Outcomes start from 26 February 2027; applicants outside Australia hear by 18 May 2027.
watch_out: The round for research periods 1 and 2 of 2027 closed on 11 September 2026; the round for periods 1 and 2 of 2028 closes on 10 September 2027.
Admission and scholarship deadlines differ for domestic and international students.

sources.title: University of Sydney: RTP scholarships for international students
